meta.originalInput: You think you're analyzing a problem. In reality, your brain is caught in a rumination loop. Real reflection moves in a straight line toward a decision. But rumination bends back on itself. Each repeated thought feeds the original anxiety, spinning the circuit faster while solving nothing. To break the cycle, you don't fight the thought. You change your physical environment. Movement forces the closed circuit to open into reality.
